scientific_integrity: The displayed universal argument uses exact coefficients and analytic inequalities; finite rational tests are supplementary. No independent audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-integer theorem is for the explicit Wang--Zhong 2026 map alone. No uniqueness or full complex critical-set classification is proved. The second-power result is antecedent literature; new proof and claim concern m>=3. Possible unpublished equivalent results are not excluded.
title: Every higher convolution power of the Dorff ellipse map loses local univalence
